feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 29 September 2026 8:03am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 29 September 2026 at 8:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong to gale force winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over Scandinavia as areas of low pressure deepen to the west of Ireland.


##Wind##

East or southeast 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 through the morning, perhaps touching gale 8 in places this evening, veering south 4 or 5, occasionally 6 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in the west later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain arriving from the southwest later this evening and overnight, heavy at times. Clearing through the morning tomorrow to become mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South 4 or 5, increasing south or southeast 4 to 6 towards midday Wednesday, then decreasing west or southwest 3 or 4 overnight into Thursday.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
